items.statement: Determine whether the difference in out-of-plane magnetic response between the fixed 4a and 4c pentalene systems persists when core geometry and probe placement are controlled. Distinguish a substituent association from a geometric or measurement artifact, and assess the extent of an aromaticity interpretation.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Using the wrong ring, replacing NICS by a charge, copying laboratory zz without the coordinate transform, forcing ring/side equality, or declaring constrained controls to be equilibrium minima.
